# Better Body Bootcamp

> Better Body Bootcamp is a coach-led group fitness gym with four studios in New York City: Astoria, Bayside, and Fresh Meadows in Queens, plus Williamsburg in Brooklyn. Every class caps at 20 people and is programmed and led by a coach. Operating since 2011; under new ownership since October 2025. New members get a two-week unlimited trial for $49.

Key facts:
- Classes: bootcamp, HIIT, strength, and conditioning, seven days a week, scaled to every level
- Class size: capped at 20 people, always coach-led (not a self-serve gym floor)
- Personal training: one-on-one and small-group available at every studio
- Trial: 2 weeks unlimited for $49 (new members)
- Memberships: monthly from about $189/mo; six-month and annual options lower the rate; no enrollment fee

## Locations

- [Astoria gym](https://betterbodybootcamp.com/locations/astoria): 31-18 Steinway Street, Astoria, NY 11103. (718) 704-9954. Near the N/W at Astoria Blvd. Serves Astoria, Long Island City, Sunnyside, Woodside, Ditmars.
- [Bayside gym](https://betterbodybootcamp.com/locations/bayside): 34-47 Bell Blvd, Bayside, NY 11361. (646) 566-8870. Near the LIRR Bayside station. Serves Bayside, Bay Terrace, Whitestone, Douglaston, Little Neck.
- [Fresh Meadows gym](https://betterbodybootcamp.com/locations/fresh-meadows): 76-46 164th Street, Fresh Meadows, NY 11366. (646) 566-8207. Easy street parking. Serves Fresh Meadows, Utopia, Hillcrest, Jamaica Estates, Flushing, Kew Gardens Hills.
- [Williamsburg gym](https://betterbodybootcamp.com/locations/williamsburg): 487 Driggs Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11211. (718) 683-1864. Near the Bedford Ave L. Serves Williamsburg, Greenpoint, East Williamsburg, Bushwick.

## Getting started

- [Start the $49 two-week trial](https://betterbodybootcamp.com/trial): unlimited classes at any studio for 14 days.
- [Class schedule](https://betterbodybootcamp.com/classes): live schedules for all four studios.
- [Pricing and membership](https://betterbodybootcamp.com/pricing): trial, monthly, and annual options.
- [Services](https://betterbodybootcamp.com/services): group training, small group, 1-on-1 personal training, InBody scans, nutrition consultations.
- [FAQ](https://betterbodybootcamp.com/faq): first-class expectations, what to bring, cancellation policy.
- [About](https://betterbodybootcamp.com/about): the story since 2011 and the coaching approach.
- [Contact](https://betterbodybootcamp.com/contact): reach any studio by phone or message.
